subject.statement: Greg Abel replaced Warren Buffett as Berkshire Hathaway's chairman and CEO.
disambiguators: replaced Warren Buffett as Berkshire Hathaway's chairman and CEO

summary: As of October 1, 2026, Greg Abel is the Chief Executive Officer of Berkshire Hathaway, a role he assumed on January 1, 2026 after Warren Buffett stepped down as CEO. He did not become chairman; Howard G. Buffett was elected Chairman effective September 18, 2026, with Warren Buffett becoming Chairman Emeritus at that time. The evidence supports the CEO transition with high confidence and shows the chairman succession unfolded later in the year, yielding a mixed verdict on the original claim.

findings.statement: Greg Abel became Chief Executive Officer of Berkshire Hathaway on January 1, 2026.
Warren Buffett ceased as CEO on January 1, 2026 and remained Chairman until September 18, 2026, when he became Chairman Emeritus.
Howard G. Buffett was elected Chairman of the Board effective September 18, 2026; Greg Abel did not become chairman.
As of the September 18, 2026 press release, Greg Abel held the title of Chief Executive Officer; no evidence indicates a change by October 1, 2026.

conflict_notes: Some sources (PBS, Britannica, SEC filing) indicated Warren Buffett remained chairman after stepping down as CEO in January 2026, while the Yahoo Finance article framed the September 18, 2026 press release as Buffett "stepping down as chairman" on that date. The conflict was resolved by weighing the authoritative SEC filing and Berkshire Hathaway’s own press release, which show Buffett continued as chairman until the September 18, 2026 election of Howard G. Buffett, after which he became chairman emeritus.
